auth.brand.body.text: Chats, groups, channels and calls, end-to-end encrypted by default. Lakko's servers never see your messages.
auth.brand.body.comment: Text under the headline on the brand panel beside the sign-in and sign-up forms.

auth.brand.foot.text: Open source. No phone number required.
auth.brand.foot.comment: Small line at the bottom of the brand panel.

auth.brand.tagline.comment: Headline on the brand panel beside the sign-in and sign-up forms.

auth.error.wrong_credentials.text: Wrong username or password. Check them and try again.
auth.error.wrong_credentials.comment: Sign-in failed. Deliberately does not say which of the two was wrong, so nobody can find out which usernames exist.

auth.explainer.never_leaves.text: Your password never leaves your device. Lakko checks it without ever receiving it, so nobody at Lakko can read it, and nobody can reset it for you.
auth.explainer.never_leaves.comment: First paragraph of the password explanation.

auth.explainer.same_answer.text: A wrong username and a wrong password get the same answer, so nobody can use the login screen to find out which usernames exist.
auth.explainer.same_answer.comment: Second paragraph of the password explanation.

auth.explainer.title.comment: Link that expands an explanation of how the password is protected.

auth.explainer.ways_back.text: If you forget it, your recovery phrase, another device that is still logged in, three words from the phrase, an authenticator app, or a code sent by email or phone get you back in.
auth.explainer.ways_back.comment: Third paragraph of the password explanation: the ways back into an account.

auth.explainer.ways_back_no_words.text: If you forget it, your recovery phrase, another device that is still logged in, an authenticator app, or a code sent by email or phone get you back in.
auth.explainer.ways_back_no_words.comment: Last paragraph of the password explanation on a client that has no three-word recovery.

auth.language.button.comment: Accessibility label of the globe button on the sign-in and sign-up screens.

auth.login.forgot.comment: Link from the sign-in screen to the recovery screen.

auth.login.no_account.comment: Line under the sign-in form; {link} is the 'Create account' link.

auth.login.passkey.comment: Button that signs in with a passkey instead of the password.

auth.login.submit.comment: Sign-in button, and the link to the sign-in screen from other auth screens.

auth.login.submitting.comment: Busy label of the sign-in button.

auth.passkey.error.cancelled.comment: The person closed the passkey prompt.

auth.passkey.error.failed_status.comment: Passkey sign-in failed; {status} is an HTTP status number, keep it in Latin digits.

auth.passkey.error.generic.text: Could not sign in with the passkey. Try again, or use your password.
auth.passkey.error.generic.comment: Passkey sign-in failed for a reason with no more specific message.

auth.passkey.error.network.comment: The connection failed during passkey sign-in.

auth.passkey.error.no_cached.text: No cached credentials for passkey sign-in on this device. Sign in with password or recover with your phrase first.
auth.passkey.error.no_cached.comment: Passkey sign-in needs a previous sign-in on this device.

auth.passkey.error.not_registered.text: No passkey is registered for this account. Sign in with password first, then add a passkey from Home.
auth.passkey.error.not_registered.comment: No passkey exists for the account.

auth.passkey.error.server_disabled.comment: The server has passkeys switched off.

auth.passkey.error.unsupported.comment: Passkeys are not available in this browser.

auth.passkey.error.wrong_account.text: This passkey belongs to a different account than the one on this device. Log in with your password first.
auth.passkey.error.wrong_account.comment: Passkey sign-in refused: the passkey chosen is for another account than the one saved on this device.

auth.password.confirm.label.comment: Label of the second password field on the sign-up form.

auth.password.error.mismatch.text: The passwords do not match. Type the same password twice.

auth.password.error.too_short.text: Use at least {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
auth.password.error.too_short.comment: The new password is too short; {count} is the minimum length.

auth.password.hide.comment: Accessibility label of the button that hides the typed password again.

auth.password.hint.text: At least {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
auth.password.hint.comment: Helper text under a password field that sets a new password, before anything is typed.

auth.password.new.label.comment: Label of the new password field on the recovery forms.

auth.password.new_confirm.label.comment: Label of the second new-password field on the recovery forms.

auth.password.show.comment: Accessibility label of the button that reveals the typed password.

auth.signup.error.fix_name.comment: Sign-up submitted with a profile name that is not allowed.

auth.signup.error.generic.text: Could not create the account. Try again.
auth.signup.error.generic.comment: Sign-up failed for a reason with no more specific message.

auth.signup.error.rate_limited.text: Too many new accounts from this network right now. Try again later.
auth.signup.error.rate_limited.comment: The server limits new accounts per network.

auth.signup.error.username_taken.text: That username is taken. Choose another one.
auth.signup.error.username_taken.comment: The chosen username belongs to someone else.

auth.signup.have_account.comment: Line under the sign-up form; {link} is the 'Log in' link.

auth.signup.lede.text: Your password never leaves your device. You will get a recovery phrase to write down next.

auth.signup.name.hint.text: Shown to your contacts. Leave it empty to show your username.
auth.signup.name.hint.comment: Helper text under the optional name field on the sign-up form.

auth.signup.name.label.comment: Label of the optional profile name field on the sign-up form.

auth.signup.submit.comment: Sign-up button, and the link to the sign-up screen from the sign-in screen.

auth.signup.username.hint.text: Latin letters, digits and _. Others find you by this name.
auth.signup.username.hint.comment: Helper text under the username field on the sign-up form, shown while the name is fine.

auth.signup.working.line.text: This takes a little while, once. You will not wait like this again.
auth.signup.working.line.comment: Line under the busy row while an account is created.

auth.signup.working.title.comment: Busy row while the account is created; this takes a while once.

auth.username.label.comment: Label of the username field on the sign-in, sign-up and recovery forms.

backup.rollback_refused.body.text: The server returned an altered or outdated backup. Your account is safe; we continued without restoring the older data.
backup.rollback_refused.body.comment: Body of the alert shown when a restore refused a backup the server returned rolled back or altered (ADR-0037). Nothing older was loaded.

backup.rollback_refused.title.text: Backup could not be restored safely
backup.rollback_refused.title.comment: Title of the alert shown when a restore refused a rolled-back or altered backup from the server.

backup.stale_restore.body.text: This backup is older than expected ({reason}). {consequence}
backup.stale_restore.body.comment: Dialog body; {reason} says why it was judged old (e.g. how long ago it was signed); {consequence} is the consequence sentence, passed already translated.

backup.stale_restore.confirm.comment: Destructive button: proceeds past the warning.

backup.stale_restore.consequence.text: Restoring it will roll your account back to older state — older messages, and devices you removed may reappear.
backup.stale_restore.consequence.comment: What restoring an older backup does; "devices you removed may reappear" is the security consequence and must stay explicit.

backup.stale_restore.reason.anchor_unrea.text: this device's record of your last backup is unreadable or was tampered with
backup.stale_restore.reason.anchor_unrea.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: the local record of the last backup could not be read.

backup.stale_restore.reason.below_floor.text: older than the last backup restored on this device
backup.stale_restore.reason.below_floor.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: the backup is older than one this device already restored.

backup.stale_restore.reason.head_strippe.text: its signature was removed and it differs from the last backup this device knew
backup.stale_restore.reason.head_strippe.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: the backup came without its signed header and does not match the last known backup.

backup.stale_restore.reason.too_old.text: it was signed longer ago than a current backup would be
backup.stale_restore.reason.too_old.comment: Phrase inside the parentheses of backup.stale_restore.body: on a new device, the backup's signature is older than the allowed window.

backup.stale_restore.title.comment: Confirmation dialog title when the backup found is older than the newest one this account has made (a possible rollback).

call.guest.default_name.comment: Name prefilled for a visitor without an account who joins a call from a link; it becomes the new account's profile name.

call.guest.working.title.comment: Busy row while a guest account is created to join a call from a link.

call.link.dead.text: This call has ended or is not active.

call.link.end_current.comment: Button shown when another call is already in progress.

call.link.ended.comment: The call ended while the page was open.

call.link.error.generic.comment: Call-link page: the call failed and no more specific reason is known.

call.link.failed.comment: Joining failed; {reason} is a sentence explaining why.

call.link.host.comment: Who invited you; {name} is a contact or profile name.

call.link.invalid.text: This call link is invalid or has expired.
call.link.invalid.comment: The call link cannot be used.

call.link.join.comment: Button for anyone joining from the link.

call.link.live.comment: The joiner is in the call.

call.link.loading.comment: Shown while the call link is read.

call.link.start.comment: Button for the owner of the call link.

call.link.title_join.comment: Title of the call-link page for anyone else.

call.link.title_start.comment: Title of the call-link page for the call's owner.

call.link.waiting.text: Waiting for the owner to admit you...
call.link.waiting.comment: The owner must let the joiner in.

call.link.waiting_hint.text: You can leave this screen; you will join when you are admitted.

chats.empty.select.text: Select a chat to start messaging
chats.empty.select.comment: Hint in the empty main pane when no chat is open.

common.adding.comment: Add button while the item is being added.

common.back.comment: Accessibility label of the back arrow in a screen's top bar.

common.cancel.comment: Button that stops the operation in progress and returns to the form.

common.checking.comment: Busy label of a submit button while what was typed is checked.

common.close.comment: Accessibility label of a button that closes a sheet or dialog, e.g. the language list opened from the sign-in screen.

common.collapse.comment: Accessibility label of the arrow that closes an expanded row.

common.confirm.comment: Button that confirms what the screen asks for.

common.confirming.comment: Confirm button while the confirmation is being sent.

common.connecting.comment: Progress label while a connection is being set up.

common.continue.comment: Button that moves a form to its next step.

common.copied.comment: Label the Copy button shows for a moment after it copied.

common.copy.comment: Button that copies the text next to it to the clipboard.

common.dismiss.comment: Button (and accessibility label) that hides a notice.

common.email.comment: Label of an email address option or field.

common.error.a11y.comment: Spoken by the screen reader for an inline error under a field. {message} is the error text.

common.error.offline.text: Could not reach Lakko. Check your connection and try again.
common.error.offline.comment: Error when the device could not reach the server at all.

common.error.qr_render.text: Could not draw the code. Try again.
common.error.qr_render.comment: A QR code (a pairing code or an authenticator setup code) could not be drawn on screen.

common.error.server_unreachable.text: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
common.error.server_unreachable.comment: Error when the server could not be reached.

common.error.session_ended.text: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
common.error.session_ended.comment: The signed-in session is gone; the action needs a new sign-in.

common.error.session_expired.comment: The server no longer accepts this session.

common.error.session_not_ready.comment: An action was tried before the signed-in session finished loading.

common.error.too_many_attempts.text: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
common.error.too_many_attempts.comment: The server is limiting attempts for a short time. Never means the account is locked or the input was wrong.

common.error.too_many_attempts_minutes.text: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
common.error.too_many_attempts_minutes.comment: The server is limiting attempts; {minutes} is how long to wait, in minutes.

common.error.unavailable.text: That is not available right now. Try again later.
common.error.unavailable.comment: Error when the server refused because a service is temporarily down.

common.expand.comment: Accessibility label of the arrow that opens a collapsed row.

common.loading.comment: Shown while a screen is still loading.

common.looking_up.comment: Busy label of a button while an account is looked up.

common.manage.comment: Row action that opens a page where something is managed (devices, passkeys).

common.more_options.comment: Title of a collapsed section with less common choices.

common.off.comment: State of a switch that is off.

common.on.comment: State of a switch that is on.

common.open_lakko.comment: Link from a public page (call or invite link) into the app.

common.optional.comment: Placeholder of a field that may be left empty.

common.paste.comment: Button that pastes the clipboard into a form.

common.phone.comment: Label of the phone option (as opposed to email).

common.preparing.comment: Shown while something is being set up.

common.remove.comment: Button that removes an item from a list (a passkey, a device, a recovery factor).

common.removing.comment: Remove button while the item is being removed.

common.saving.comment: Save button while the change is being saved.

common.sending.comment: Busy label of a button while a code is being sent.

common.set_up.comment: Row action that opens a page where something is set up for the first time.

common.try_again.comment: Button that repeats an operation that failed.

common.unknown.comment: Shown in place of a date or value that could not be read.

device_link.compare_hint.text: Make sure the other device shows the same code.
device_link.compare_hint.comment: Instruction under the comparison code on the new device.

device_link.comparison_code.comment: Label over the code the person compares between the two devices.

device_link.confirm_there.text: Open Lakko on a device that is already signed in and confirm this sign-in there.
device_link.confirm_there.comment: Instruction on the new device while it waits for another device to confirm.

device_link.error.ask_unavailable.text: Asking your other device is not available right now; the QR code still works.
device_link.error.ask_unavailable.comment: The server cannot pass the request to other devices; the QR code is offered instead.

device_link.error.ask_unreachable.text: Could not reach the server to ask your other device; the QR code still works.
device_link.error.ask_unreachable.comment: The request to other devices could not be sent; the QR code is offered instead.

device_link.error.declined.comment: The other device refused the sign-in.

device_link.error.generic.text: Could not restore from your other device. Try again, or use your recovery phrase.
device_link.error.generic.comment: Restoring from another device failed for a reason with no more specific message.

device_link.error.identity_mismatch.text: The identity received from your other device doesn't match this account's published identity — refusing to use it.
device_link.error.identity_mismatch.comment: The identity from the other device does not match the account; it is refused for safety.

device_link.error.name_other_account.text: The name you typed belongs to a different account. Nothing was changed on this device.
device_link.error.name_other_account.comment: Restoring from another device: the username typed on this device resolves to a different account than the one the other device answered for, so nothing was saved.

device_link.error.no_identity.text: The other device confirmed but did not send your identity. Update Lakko on it and try again, or use your recovery phrase.
device_link.error.no_identity.comment: The other device confirmed without sending the identity.

device_link.error.not_let_in.text: Your other device sent the identity, but this device could not be let in. Try again, or use your recovery phrase.
device_link.error.not_let_in.comment: The identity arrived but signing in on this device failed.

device_link.error.request_limited.text: Too many requests to your other devices. Try again in a few minutes.
device_link.error.request_limited.comment: The server limits how often other devices are asked.

device_link.error.timeout.text: The other device did not answer in time. Try again.
device_link.error.timeout.comment: Nobody confirmed on another device in time.

device_link.pairing.needs_username.text: Set a username first to add another device.
device_link.pairing.needs_username.comment: An account without a username cannot add another device.

device_link.pairing.unsupported.text: This code comes from a different version of Lakko. Update Lakko on both devices and try again.
device_link.pairing.unsupported.comment: The new device runs a version this one cannot read.

device_link.pairing.wrong_account.text: This code is for a different account. Check that the new device uses the same username as this one.
device_link.pairing.wrong_account.comment: The new device asked to join a different account.

device_link.qr.hide.comment: Button that hides the QR code again.

device_link.qr.intro.text: Show this code to a device that still has your account. It adds this device and transfers your identity end-to-end encrypted, with no phrase to type.
device_link.qr.intro.comment: Line above the pairing code shown on a new device.

device_link.qr.scan_hint.text: On your other device, open Settings, then Devices, then Add a device, and scan this code.
device_link.qr.scan_hint.comment: Instruction under the pairing QR code.

device_link.qr.show.comment: Button that shows a QR code as an alternative to confirming.

device_link.qr.waiting.text: Waiting for your other device to scan this code...
device_link.qr.waiting.comment: Shown under the pairing QR code while the other device has not scanned it yet.

device_link.request.added.comment: Shown after a new device was added.

device_link.request.adding.comment: Busy label while the new device is added.

device_link.request.body.text: A new device is asking to join your account. It shows a code.
device_link.request.body.comment: Text of the prompt on a signed-in device when a new device asks to join.

device_link.request.code_label.comment: Label over the code the new device shows.

device_link.request.confirm.comment: Button that lets a new device into the account.

device_link.request.confirm_only_if.text: Confirm only if the new device shows exactly this code.
device_link.request.confirm_only_if.comment: Instruction: compare the code before confirming.

device_link.request.decline.comment: Button that refuses a new device's request to join.

device_link.request.declined.text: Declined. If this keeps happening, change your password.
device_link.request.declined.comment: Shown after the request was refused.

device_link.request.error.generic.text: Could not add the device. Try again.
device_link.request.error.generic.comment: Adding the new device failed for a reason with no more specific message.

device_link.request.error.no_device_key.text: No device key on this browser. Sign in again.
device_link.request.error.no_device_key.comment: This browser lost its device key; signing in again fixes it.

device_link.request.title.comment: Title of the prompt on a signed-in device when a new device asks to join.

device_link.restored.comment: Shown when the restore from another device finished.

device_link.show_code.comment: Button that starts the another-device sign-in and shows the code.

device_link.transferring.comment: Shown while the identity arrives from the other device.

devices.add.e2ee_note.text: Linking is end-to-end encrypted between your two devices.
devices.add.e2ee_note.comment: Line at the top of the add-a-device screen.

devices.add.error.generic.text: Could not link this device. Try again.

devices.add.joining.comment: Progress on the new device after the other device scanned its code.

devices.add.linked.text: Linked. This device is now part of your account.
devices.add.linked.comment: The new device was linked to the account.

devices.add.side.scan.comment: Segment on the add-a-device screen: this device is signed in, it scans the new device's code.

devices.add.side.scan_detail.text: This device is already signed in: it scans the new device's code and lets it in.

devices.add.side.show.comment: Segment on the add-a-device screen: this is the new device, it shows its code.

devices.add.side.show_detail.text: This is the new device: it joins your account once another device scans its code.

devices.add.sign_in_first.text: Sign in first to add a device.
devices.add.sign_in_first.comment: The add-a-device screen was opened without a session.

devices.add.title.comment: Title of the screen that links a new device to the account.

devices.scan.confirm.body.text: This gives the scanned device full access to your account: your messages, your contacts and your identity. Continue only if the code is on your own new device.
devices.scan.confirm.body.comment: Warning before the scanned device is let into the account.

devices.scan.confirm.submit.comment: Confirms letting the scanned device into the account.

devices.scan.confirm.title.comment: Asked after a pairing code was scanned, before the new device is let in.

devices.scan.error.camera_denied.text: Lakko cannot use the camera. Allow camera access in Settings, then try again.
devices.scan.error.camera_denied.comment: Camera access for scanning a pairing code was refused or failed.

devices.scan.error.camera_failed.text: The camera could not start. Try again.
devices.scan.error.camera_failed.comment: The camera started but the scanner could not attach to it.

devices.scan.error.no_camera.text: No back camera is available on this device.
devices.scan.error.no_camera.comment: The camera needed to scan a pairing code is missing.

devices.scan.error.not_a_code.text: That is not a Lakko device code. Point the camera at the code on your other device.
devices.scan.error.not_a_code.comment: Hint over the camera when it sees a QR code that is not a Lakko pairing code; scanning goes on.

devices.scan.intro.text: Point your camera at the code your new device is showing.
devices.scan.intro.comment: Instruction on the signed-in device before it scans the new device's code.

devices.scan.open_camera.comment: Button that starts the camera to scan a pairing code.

display_name.error.control.comment: Shown under a name field that contains invisible or text-direction characters.

display_name.error.line_break.comment: Shown under a name field that contains a line break.

display_name.error.too_long.text: At most {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
display_name.error.too_long.comment: Shown under a name field that is too long; {count} is the maximum.

display_name.error.too_many_bytes.comment: Shown under a name field that is too long to store.

display_name.error.unknown.comment: Shown under a name field for any other refusal.

language.name.ar.comment: Name of the Arabic language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.en.comment: Name of the English language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.es.comment: Name of the Spanish language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.fa.comment: Name of the Persian (Farsi) language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.he.comment: Name of the Hebrew language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.hi.comment: Name of the Hindi language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.pt-br.comment: Name of Brazilian Portuguese, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.ru.comment: Name of the Russian language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.tr.comment: Name of the Turkish language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.uk.comment: Name of the Ukrainian language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.zh-hans.comment: Name of Simplified Chinese, shown under its own name in the language list.

recovery.access_only_note.text: An authenticator or a code gets you back in; your chats then need your recovery phrase or another device.
recovery.access_only_note.comment: Note under the list of recovery methods.

recovery.cached_account.comment: On a recovery form, names the account saved on this device. {username} is '@name'.

recovery.contact.change.text: Use a different email or phone
recovery.contact.change.comment: Button back to the first step of the email-or-phone recovery.

recovery.contact.code_label.comment: Label of the field for the code sent by email or phone.

recovery.contact.email_label.comment: Label of the email field in email-or-phone recovery.

recovery.contact.error.bad_contact.text: That does not look like an email address or phone number. Check it and try again.
recovery.contact.error.bad_contact.comment: The server refused the email address or phone number.

recovery.contact.error.enter_code.text: Enter the six-digit code we sent.
recovery.contact.error.enter_code.comment: The code field is empty or not six digits.

recovery.contact.error.generic.text: Could not check the code. Try again.
recovery.contact.error.generic.comment: Email-or-phone recovery failed for a reason with no more specific message.

recovery.contact.error.invalid_email.comment: The email address does not look valid.

recovery.contact.error.invalid_phone.text: Enter the phone number in international format, like +15551234567.
recovery.contact.error.invalid_phone.comment: The phone number does not look valid. Keep the example number as is.

recovery.contact.error.send_failed.text: Could not send a code. Check the username and try again.
recovery.contact.error.send_failed.comment: The code could not be sent.

recovery.contact.error.unavailable.text: Email and phone recovery are not available here. Use another way in.
recovery.contact.error.unavailable.comment: The server has email and phone recovery switched off.

recovery.contact.error.wrong.text: That code did not work. Check the code we sent and try again.
recovery.contact.error.wrong.comment: The code sent by email or phone was not accepted.

recovery.contact.intro.text: We send a six-digit code to the email address or phone number you set up in Settings. It gets you back in; your chats then need your recovery phrase or another device.

recovery.contact.phone_label.comment: Label of the phone number field.

recovery.contact.send.comment: Button that sends the recovery code.

recovery.contact.send_by.comment: Accessibility label of the Email / Phone choice.

recovery.contact.sent_email.text: If that address is set up for this account, a six-digit code is on its way. Enter it below.
recovery.contact.sent_email.comment: Shown after a code was requested by email. Deliberately does not confirm the address is on the account.

recovery.contact.sent_phone.text: If that number is set up for this account, a six-digit code is on its way. Enter it below.
recovery.contact.sent_phone.comment: Shown after a code was requested by phone. Deliberately does not confirm the number is on the account.

recovery.device.intro.text: Enter your username, then confirm on a device that is still logged in and compare the code it shows. Nothing is sent that Lakko's servers can read. No camera needed; a QR code is there if you prefer.

recovery.device.intro_qr.text: Your other device links this one and carries your account across.
recovery.device.intro_qr.comment: Line under the 'Another device' recovery title when the link runs by scanning a QR code.

recovery.device.restoring.comment: Heading while another device restores the account; {username} is the username with @.

recovery.error.code_send_limited.text: We sent a code recently. Wait a few minutes before asking for another.
recovery.error.code_send_limited.comment: The server limits how often a recovery code is sent.

recovery.error.generic.text: Could not recover the account. Check the words and try again.
recovery.error.generic.comment: Recovery failed for a reason with no more specific message.

recovery.error.no_match.text: That did not match this account. Check the words and the username, then try again.
recovery.error.no_match.comment: Recovery failed. Deliberately the same whether the username or the words were wrong.

recovery.lede.text: Choose how to get back in.
recovery.lede.comment: Line under the recovery title, above the list of methods.

recovery.lede_account.text: Choose how to get back into {username}.
recovery.lede_account.comment: Line under the recovery title when an account is saved on this device; {username} is its username with @.

recovery.method.contact.sub.text: A code sent to the email or phone you set up.

recovery.method.phrase.restore_sub.comment: Subtitle of the recovery phrase method on the restore-identity screen.

recovery.method.shares.sub.text: The shares you gave to people you trust.
recovery.method.shares.sub.comment: Subtitle of the social recovery shares method.

recovery.method.shares.title.comment: Recovery method: pieces of the recovery phrase given to trusted people.

recovery.method.totp.sub.text: A code from your authenticator app.

recovery.method.totp.title.comment: Recovery method: a code from an authenticator app.

recovery.method.words.restore_sub.text: Three words from your recovery phrase.
recovery.method.words.restore_sub.comment: Subtitle of the three-words method on the restore-identity screen.

recovery.method.words.sub.text: Three words from your phrase, if that shortcut is on.

recovery.method.words.title.comment: Recovery method: type three words from the recovery phrase.

recovery.remembered.comment: Line at the bottom of the recovery screen; {link} is the 'Log in' link.

recovery.shares.copy_failed.text: Could not copy. Select the share and copy it by hand.

recovery.shares.error.combine_failed.text: Could not combine the shares. Check that each one is complete and try again.
recovery.shares.error.combine_failed.comment: The pasted shares could not be combined.

recovery.shares.error.generic.text: Could not make the shares. Try again.

recovery.shares.error.too_few.text: Paste at least two shares, one per line.
recovery.shares.error.too_few.comment: Fewer than two shares were pasted.

recovery.shares.generate.text: Generate {count, plural, one {# share} other {# shares}}
recovery.shares.generate.comment: Button that splits the phrase into shares.

recovery.shares.generating.comment: Busy label while the shares are made.

recovery.shares.help.text: Paste them exactly as they were sent. You need as many as were agreed when they were made, usually 3 of 5.

recovery.shares.intro.text: Paste the shares you were given, one per line, then choose a new password.
recovery.shares.intro.comment: Instructions of the social recovery form.

recovery.shares.label.comment: Label of the box the social recovery shares are pasted into.

recovery.shares.panel_body.text: Split the phrase into {count, plural, one {# share} other {# shares}} for people you trust. Any {threshold} of them rebuild it; fewer reveal nothing. Give each person one share.
recovery.shares.panel_body.comment: Explains social recovery shares; {count} is how many are made, {threshold} how many rebuild the phrase.

recovery.shares.usage.text: To use them later, choose {method} on the recovery screen and paste any {threshold}.
recovery.shares.usage.comment: How to use the shares; {method} is the name of the recovery method, {threshold} how many are needed.

recovery.submit.comment: Submit button of the recovery forms.

recovery.title.comment: Title of the account recovery screen.

recovery.totp.code_label.comment: Label of the authenticator code field.

recovery.totp.error.enter_code.text: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
recovery.totp.error.enter_code.comment: The authenticator code field is empty or not six digits.

recovery.totp.error.generic.text: Could not check the code. Try again.
recovery.totp.error.generic.comment: Authenticator recovery failed for a reason with no more specific message.

recovery.totp.error.unavailable.text: Authenticator recovery is not available here. Use another way in.
recovery.totp.error.unavailable.comment: The server has authenticator recovery switched off.

recovery.totp.error.wrong.text: That code did not work. Check the app and try the next one.
recovery.totp.error.wrong.comment: The authenticator code was not accepted.

recovery.totp.error.wrong_username.text: That code did not work. Check the username and the app, then try again.
recovery.totp.error.wrong_username.comment: The authenticator code or the username was not accepted.

recovery.totp.intro.text: Use the six-digit code from the authenticator app you set up in Settings. It gets you back in; your chats then need your recovery phrase or another device.

recovery.username_required.text: Enter the username of the account.
recovery.username_required.comment: A recovery form was submitted without a username.

recovery.username_required_to_recover.text: Enter the username of the account to recover.
recovery.username_required_to_recover.comment: Recovery was started with no username typed and none remembered on this device.

recovery.words.error.generic.text: Could not check the words. Try again.
recovery.words.error.generic.comment: The three-word check failed for a reason with no more specific message.

recovery.words.error.no_match_tries.text: Those words did not match. {count, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}} before the three-word shortcut is switched off.
recovery.words.error.no_match_tries.comment: The three words were wrong; {count} wrong answers remain before the shortcut is destroyed.

recovery.words.error.open_failed.text: The server answered, but the recovery data did not open. Nothing was changed.
recovery.words.error.open_failed.comment: The server released the recovery data but it could not be opened.

recovery.words.error.server_off.text: Three-word recovery is not available on this server.
recovery.words.error.server_off.comment: The server has the three-word shortcut switched off.

recovery.words.intro.text: Type three words from your recovery phrase and choose a new password. First, which account?
recovery.words.intro.comment: Instructions of the three-words form, before the account is chosen.

recovery.words.prompt.text: {username}: type words {positions} of your recovery phrase.
recovery.words.prompt.comment: Which words to type. {username} is the account (@name, shown bold); {positions} is a list of word numbers such as '5, 14 and 21', shown bold, in Latin digits.

recovery.words.prompt_restore.text: Type words {positions} of your recovery phrase.
recovery.words.prompt_restore.comment: Which words to type on the restore-identity screen; {positions} is a list of word numbers in Latin digits, shown bold.

recovery.words.switched_off.text: The three-word shortcut is now switched off for this account. Use your full recovery phrase or another device.
recovery.words.switched_off.comment: Too many wrong answers: the server destroyed the three-word shortcut.

recovery.words.switched_off_restore.text: The three-word shortcut is now switched off for this account. Use another device or your full recovery phrase.
recovery.words.switched_off_restore.comment: Too many wrong answers on the restore-identity screen: the server destroyed the three-word shortcut.

recovery.words.tries_left.text: {count, plural, one {# try left.} other {# tries left.}}
recovery.words.tries_left.comment: How many wrong answers remain before the three-word shortcut is switched off.

recovery.words.unavailable.text: Three-word recovery is not available here. Use another way in.
recovery.words.unavailable.comment: The three-word shortcut is off for this account or server.

recovery_phrase.check.acknowledge.text: I understand that losing these words means losing access to this account.
recovery_phrase.check.acknowledge.comment: Checkbox the person ticks before finishing.

recovery_phrase.check.back.comment: Button back to the recovery phrase.

recovery_phrase.check.lede.text: Type words {positions} from what you wrote down.
recovery_phrase.check.lede.comment: Which words to type back; {positions} is a list of word numbers in Latin digits.

recovery_phrase.check.mismatch_many.text: Words {positions} do not match. Check your notes and try again.
recovery_phrase.check.mismatch_many.comment: Several typed words were wrong; {positions} is a list of numbers in Latin digits.

recovery_phrase.check.mismatch_one.text: Word {position} does not match. Check your notes and try again.
recovery_phrase.check.mismatch_one.comment: One typed word was wrong; {position} is its number in Latin digits.

recovery_phrase.check.title.comment: Title of the step that checks the phrase was written down.

recovery_phrase.copy_failed.text: Could not copy. Write the words down instead.

recovery_phrase.error.incomplete.text: Enter all 24 words of your recovery phrase.
recovery_phrase.error.incomplete.comment: The recovery phrase fields were submitted empty.

recovery_phrase.fresh.acknowledge.text: I have written down these 24 words and understand that losing them means losing access to this account.
recovery_phrase.fresh.acknowledge.comment: Checkbox the person ticks before finishing.

recovery_phrase.fresh.error.generic.comment: Finishing after the new phrase failed.

recovery_phrase.fresh.finishing.comment: Busy label while the new identity is finished.

recovery_phrase.fresh.lede.text: You created a new identity for {username}. These 24 words are the only way to recover it if you lose access again. Write them down in order and keep them somewhere safe.
recovery_phrase.fresh.lede.comment: After creating a new identity; {username} is the account (@name, shown bold).

recovery_phrase.fresh.safety_note.text: Your contacts will see that your safety number changed and will need to verify you again before messaging you securely.
recovery_phrase.fresh.safety_note.comment: Consequence of a new identity for the person's contacts.

recovery_phrase.fresh.title.comment: Title of the screen that shows the phrase of a newly created identity.

recovery_phrase.guest.lede.text: Your account was created without a password. These 24 words are the only way back into it on another device or after clearing this browser. Write them down in order and keep them somewhere safe.
recovery_phrase.guest.lede.comment: For an account created without a password (a guest from a call link).

recovery_phrase.label.comment: Label of the recovery phrase grid and input.

recovery_phrase.save.anyone_with_words.text: Anyone who has these words can read your messages and act as you. Do not share them.
recovery_phrase.save.anyone_with_words.comment: Warning under the 24 words on the save-your-phrase screen.

recovery_phrase.save.lede.text: These 24 words are the only way back into your account if you lose your password and your devices. Write them down in order and keep them somewhere safe.
recovery_phrase.save.lede.comment: Why the recovery phrase matters and what to do with it.

recovery_phrase.save.no_screenshot.text: Do not keep them as a screenshot or in a plain text file. Lakko cannot show them again.

recovery_phrase.save.title.comment: Title of the screen that shows a new recovery phrase.

recovery_phrase.save.vault_note.text: On a new device you will usually be asked for just three of these, words {positions}. Keep the whole list anyway: it is the only way back if that shortcut is ever switched off.
recovery_phrase.save.vault_note.comment: Note about the three-word shortcut; {positions} is a list of word numbers in Latin digits.

recovery_phrase.save.written.comment: Button to go on once the recovery phrase is written down.

recovery_phrase.step.comment: Progress through the recovery phrase screens.

recovery_phrase.word_label.comment: Accessibility label of one word slot; {position} is its number in the phrase, in Latin digits.

recovery_phrase.word_placeholder.comment: Placeholder of one word slot; {position} is its number in the phrase, in Latin digits.

restore_identity.device_intro.text: A device that is still logged in shows a prompt; confirm it there and compare the code. The transfer is end-to-end encrypted; Lakko's servers cannot read it. No camera needed; a QR code is there if you prefer.

restore_identity.error.bad_saved_account.text: Something is wrong with the account saved on this device. Log out and log in again, or use your recovery phrase.
restore_identity.error.bad_saved_account.comment: The account saved on this device cannot be read, so restoring from another device cannot start.

restore_identity.error.generic.text: Could not restore your identity. Try again.
restore_identity.error.generic.comment: Restoring failed for a reason with no more specific message.

restore_identity.error.invalid_phrase.text: That is not a valid recovery phrase. Check each word and try again.
restore_identity.error.invalid_phrase.comment: The typed words are not a valid recovery phrase.

restore_identity.error.not_published.text: No published identity was found to verify the recovered identity. Try again, or restore from a device that still has your account.
restore_identity.error.not_published.comment: The account's identity could not be found to check against; refused for safety.

restore_identity.error.nothing.text: Nothing to restore. Log in first.
restore_identity.error.nothing.comment: The restore screen was reached without a sign-in.

restore_identity.error.phrase_mismatch.text: That recovery phrase doesn't match this account's identity. Check the phrase, or pair an existing device instead.
restore_identity.error.phrase_mismatch.comment: The typed phrase belongs to a different identity; it is refused for safety.

restore_identity.error.unreachable.text: Could not reach the directory to verify the recovered identity. Check your connection and try again.
restore_identity.error.unreachable.comment: The identity could not be checked because the server was unreachable.

restore_identity.lede.text: You are logged in as {username} on a new device. To keep the contacts who already trust you, restore your identity with three words, your recovery phrase, or from a device that is still logged in.
restore_identity.lede.comment: Why the identity is needed; {username} is the account (@name, shown bold).

restore_identity.lede_no_words.text: You are logged in as {username} on a new device. To keep the contacts who already trust you, restore your identity with your recovery phrase, or from a device that is still logged in.
restore_identity.lede_no_words.comment: Same as the other lede, when the three-word shortcut is not available.

restore_identity.log_out.comment: Button that signs out from the restore-identity screen.

restore_identity.lost.create.comment: Button that creates a new identity (a last resort).

restore_identity.lost.creating.comment: Busy label while the new identity is created.

restore_identity.lost.error.generic.text: Could not create a new identity. Try again.

restore_identity.lost.sub.comment: Subtitle of the option for someone who has neither the recovery phrase nor another device; also the title of that screen.

restore_identity.lost.summary.text: I have neither my recovery phrase nor another device
restore_identity.lost.summary.comment: Collapsed section for someone who lost every way to restore the identity.

restore_identity.lost.warning.text: This creates a new identity for your account. Your contacts will need to verify you again, messages on your lost device stay unreadable, and you get a new recovery phrase to save. Only do this if you have lost both your recovery phrase and every other device.
restore_identity.lost.warning.comment: Warning before creating a new identity.

restore_identity.not_you.comment: Text before the Log out link on the restore-identity screen.

restore_identity.phrase_intro.text: Type the 24 words in order. Lakko checks them against your account before continuing.
restore_identity.phrase_intro.comment: Line above the 24 word fields when restoring the identity on a new device.

restore_identity.submit.comment: Button that restores the identity from the typed phrase.

restore_identity.submitting.comment: Busy label of the Restore button.

restore_identity.title.comment: Title of the screen that asks for the identity on a new device.

security.identity_changed.body.text: If that was you, on another device, dismiss this. If it was not, verify your safety numbers with your contacts and change your password and passkeys.
security.identity_changed.body.comment: Rest of the alert shown when the account's identity key changed.

security.identity_changed.title.text: Your account's security key was changed.
security.identity_changed.title.comment: Bold first sentence of the alert shown when the account's identity key changed.

settings.about.lede_web.comment: Line under the About title in Settings, web client.

settings.about.licence_body.text: {licence}. The source code is free to read, use and improve.
settings.about.licence_body.comment: {licence} is the licence name, e.g. AGPL-3.0-or-later; keep it untranslated.

settings.about.protection.body.text: Messages, calls and contact requests are end-to-end encrypted: only the people in a conversation can read them, never Lakko's servers. Your password never leaves your device, and each contact has a safety number you can compare in person.
settings.about.protection.body.comment: Explains end-to-end encryption and safety numbers.

settings.about.translations_updated.comment: Settings > About, shown when a signed translation update is active. {date} is a date formatted for the locale.

settings.account.danger_zone.footer.text: Log out keeps your data on this device. Forget this device removes it; you can only come back with your recovery phrase or another signed-in device. Delete account erases the account on the server and wipes this device; this cannot be undone.
settings.account.danger_zone.footer.comment: Note under the Log out / Forget this device / Delete account rows in Settings. The three action names are the row labels, keep them recognisable.

settings.account.delete.body.text: This erases your server-side identity — username, keys, recovery factors and backup — and signs you out everywhere. Your local messages are wiped from this device too. This cannot be undone.
settings.account.delete.body.comment: Confirmation dialog body; lists exactly what is erased.

settings.account.delete.confirm.comment: Row title, row button and destructive button of the confirmation dialog.

settings.account.delete.error.cancelled.text: Cancelled. Your account was not deleted.
settings.account.delete.error.cancelled.comment: The person dismissed the passkey prompt that confirms deleting the account; nothing was deleted.

settings.account.delete.error.generic.text: Could not delete your account. Try again.

settings.account.delete.sub.text: Permanently erases your account and everything in it, and wipes this device. This cannot be undone.

settings.account.forget_device.body.text: You'll lose the cached account on this browser. The only way back is the 24-word recovery passphrase you wrote down at signup.
settings.account.forget_device.body.comment: Confirmation dialog body: the one fact that decides whether to press the button.

settings.account.forget_device.body_devi.text: Everything on this device is removed and the device leaves your account. You will need your recovery phrase or another signed-in device to use this account here again.
settings.account.forget_device.body_devi.comment: Body of the Forget this device confirmation in the phone apps (the web wording speaks of a browser).

settings.account.forget_device.confirm.comment: Row button and destructive button of the confirmation dialog.

settings.account.forget_device.sub.text: Removes your account data from this browser. Your messages stay on your other devices; to come back here you will need your recovery phrase or another device.
settings.account.forget_device.sub.comment: What forgetting this device removes and how to come back.

settings.account.lede.text: Your data, signing out, this device, and deleting your account.
settings.account.lede.comment: Line under the Account title in Settings.

settings.account.log_out.comment: Row title and button that signs out on this device.

settings.account.log_out.body.text: Your messages stay on this device. Log back in with your password or passkey.
settings.account.log_out.body.comment: Body of the Log out confirmation.

settings.account.log_out.sub.text: Signs you out on this device. Your data stays here for the next login.
settings.account.log_out.sub.comment: What logging out does and keeps.

settings.account.log_out.title.comment: Title of the Log out confirmation.

settings.account.vault.not_set_up.text: Three-word recovery: not set up on this account yet. It is set up the next time you sign in on a device that holds your phrase.
settings.account.vault.not_set_up.comment: Recovery row when the three-word shortcut is not set up yet.

settings.account.vault.on.text: Three-word recovery: on (words {positions}). Another signed-in device and your 24-word phrase work too.
settings.account.vault.on.comment: Recovery row when the three-word shortcut is set up; {positions} is a list of word positions in Latin digits, joined by the list formatter.

settings.account.vault.unavailable.text: Three-word recovery: not available on this server. Your 24-word phrase and your other devices still work.
settings.account.vault.unavailable.comment: Recovery row in Settings > Account when the server has no three-word vault.

settings.anti_censorship.footer.text: When on, Lakko connects in a way that is harder for a network to detect and block. Your messages stay end-to-end encrypted either way.

settings.anti_censorship.status.comment: Heading above the current anti-censorship state.

settings.anti_censorship.status.active.s.text: Connections are hidden from network blocking.
settings.anti_censorship.status.active.s.comment: Line under the Active anti-censorship state.

settings.anti_censorship.status.connecti.comment: Line under Connecting... in the anti-censorship state, while the hidden connection is being set up.

settings.anti_censorship.status.direct.comment: Line under Off in the anti-censorship state: the app connects directly.

settings.anti_censorship.status.unavaila.comment: Anti-censorship state: switched on, but the hidden connection could not be set up.

settings.anti_censorship.status.unavaila.text: Could not set up the hidden connection. Check your network, then turn the switch off and on to try again.
settings.anti_censorship.status.unavaila.comment: Line under the Unavailable anti-censorship state. The technical reason goes to the log only.

settings.anti_censorship.status.unconfig.comment: Anti-censorship state: this build of the app has no configuration for it.

settings.anti_censorship.status.unconfig.text: This build was made without the setting.
settings.anti_censorship.status.unconfig.comment: Line under Not available in this build.

settings.anti_censorship.title.comment: Settings row and screen title for hiding the app's connections from network blocking.

settings.appearance.lede.comment: Line under the Appearance title in Settings.

settings.appearance.theme.comment: Label of the light / dark theme choice.

settings.appearance.theme.system.comment: Theme option: follow the device's light or dark setting.

settings.data.downloaded.comment: Confirmation after the export; {file} is the file name, keep it as is.

settings.data.error.generic.text: Could not export your data. Try again.

settings.data.export.comment: Button that downloads the account export.

settings.data.export_note.text: Your messages, contacts, and group state are end-to-end encrypted and live only on your devices.
settings.data.export_note.comment: A note written inside the exported file.

settings.data.lede.text: Download a copy of what Lakko's servers hold about your account. Your messages and contacts are end-to-end encrypted and stay on your devices, so they are not part of this file.
settings.data.lede.comment: Explains what the export contains and why messages are not in it.

settings.data.ready.text: Export ready. Tap Share to save it.
settings.data.ready.comment: Shown after the data export file was prepared; a Share button appears below.

settings.data.share.comment: Button that opens the share sheet for the prepared data export file.

settings.data.title.comment: Card heading in Settings > Account: the data export.

settings.devices.add.lede.text: Sign in to Lakko on the new device first. Then pick which of the two is showing a code.
settings.devices.add.lede.comment: Text of the Add a device panel before choosing a side.

settings.devices.add.no_camera.text: No camera on either device? Sign in on the new one and choose "{method}": an "{prompt}" prompt with a code to compare appears here.
settings.devices.add.no_camera.comment: {method} is the recovery method name "Another device"; {prompt} is the prompt title "Is this you?". Both are passed already translated.

settings.devices.device_n.comment: Row label of another device, by its order in the list; {number} is a number.

settings.devices.error.load.text: Could not load your devices. Try again.

settings.devices.error.no_device_key.text: This browser is not set up for your account. Sign in again.
settings.devices.error.no_device_key.comment: Web: this browser holds no device key for the account.

settings.devices.error.remove.text: Could not remove the device. Try again.
settings.devices.error.remove.comment: Removing a device failed or its passkey confirmation was cancelled.

settings.devices.error.scan.text: Could not add the device. Try again.

settings.devices.lede.text: The phones, tablets and computers signed in to your account. Adding one is end-to-end encrypted; Lakko's servers cannot read it.

settings.devices.list.lede.text: A removed device loses access to your messages from that moment on. Removing one may ask for your passkey.

settings.devices.remove.body.text: This device will lose access to your messages from that moment on. You may be asked for your passkey.
settings.devices.remove.body.comment: Body of the confirmation before removing one of the account's devices.

settings.devices.remove.confirm_named.comment: Destructive button of the device removal confirmation; {device} is the row label (This device / Device 2).

settings.devices.remove.title.comment: Title of the confirmation before removing one of the account's devices; {device} is the row label, e.g. Device 2.

settings.devices.scan.done.text: Device added. It will appear in the list once it has finished joining.
settings.devices.scan.done.comment: The scanned device was let in.

settings.devices.show.error.timeout.text: The other device did not scan in time. Try again.
settings.devices.show.error.timeout.comment: Nobody scanned the code before it expired.

settings.devices.show.lede.text: Scan this code with a device that is already signed in. Once it confirms, this device joins your account.
settings.devices.show.lede.comment: Text above the code this device shows.

settings.devices.show.start.comment: Button that shows this device's pairing code.

settings.devices.sign_in_first.text: Sign in first to manage devices.
settings.devices.sign_in_first.comment: Devices page without a signed-in session.

settings.devices.this_device.comment: Row label of the device the person is using.

settings.devices.this_device.sub.text: The device you are using now.
settings.devices.this_device.sub.comment: Subtitle of the This device row.

settings.devices.title.comment: Title of the devices row and of the Devices page.

settings.language.load_failed.text: Couldn't load this language. Check your connection and try again.
settings.language.load_failed.comment: Web only: the language file failed to download; the interface stays in the old language.

settings.language.no_results.comment: Shown when the search matches no language.

settings.language.same_as_system.comment: First row of the language list: follow the device's language.

settings.language.same_as_system_detail.comment: Subtitle form of the first row. {language} is the resolved language written in itself, e.g. 'Deutsch'.

settings.language.search.comment: Placeholder of the search field above the language list.

settings.language.title.comment: Title of the Settings screen that picks the interface language, and of the Settings row that opens it.

settings.me.guest.comment: Name at the top of Settings for an account that has neither a name nor a username (a guest account from a call link).

settings.media.autoplay_video_notes.sub.text: Incoming video notes start playing, muted, as they scroll into view. Off by default because autoplay downloads media.

settings.media.lede.comment: Line under the Media title in Settings.

settings.notifications.off.body.text: Notifications are off, so Lakko can only ring while it is open. Turn them on so calls and messages reach you when it is not.
settings.notifications.off.body.comment: Shown in Settings only when the system has notifications turned off for Lakko; the row opens the system notification settings.

settings.notifications.off.title.comment: Settings row shown when notifications are off for Lakko; opens the system notification settings.

settings.passkeys.add.comment: Button that creates a new passkey.

settings.passkeys.added.comment: Confirmation after a passkey is created; {name} is the name the person gave it.

settings.passkeys.added_last_used.comment: Passkey row subtitle; {added} and {used} are dates and times formatted for the locale.

settings.passkeys.added_never_used.comment: Passkey row subtitle for a passkey never used to sign in; {added} is a date and time.

settings.passkeys.error.cancelled.comment: The person dismissed the browser or system passkey sheet.

settings.passkeys.error.generic.text: Could not update your passkeys. Try again.
settings.passkeys.error.generic.comment: Fallback for any other passkey failure.

settings.passkeys.error.network.text: Network error. Check your connection and retry.
settings.passkeys.error.network.comment: The passkey request could not reach the server.

settings.passkeys.error.server_status.comment: Passkey request failed; {status} is an HTTP status code in Latin digits.

settings.passkeys.error.unsupported.text: This browser / device can't create passkeys right now.
settings.passkeys.error.unsupported.comment: The platform refused to create a passkey.

settings.passkeys.lede.text: Sign in with Touch ID, Face ID or a security key instead of your password. Your recovery phrase always works too.

settings.passkeys.lede_device.text: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock, or a security key, instead of your password. Your recovery phrase always works too.
settings.passkeys.lede_device.comment: Text at the top of the Passkeys page on a phone (Android); settings.passkeys.lede names Apple's Touch ID and Face ID.

settings.passkeys.name.label.comment: Accessibility label of the field that names a new passkey.

settings.passkeys.name.placeholder.text: Name this passkey (e.g. MacBook Touch ID)
settings.passkeys.name.placeholder.comment: Placeholder of the field that names a new passkey.

settings.passkeys.remove.body.text: The device that owns the matching private key will no longer be able to sign in with it. This cannot be undone.
settings.passkeys.remove.body.comment: Confirmation dialog body before removing a passkey.

settings.passkeys.remove.confirm.comment: Destructive button of the remove-passkey dialog when the passkey has no name.

settings.passkeys.remove.confirm_named.comment: Destructive button of the remove-passkey dialog; {name} is the passkey name, the accessible name at the point of no return.

settings.passkeys.remove.error.cancelled.text: Cancelled. The passkey was not removed.
settings.passkeys.remove.error.cancelled.comment: The person dismissed the passkey prompt that confirms removing a passkey; it was kept.

settings.passkeys.remove.title.comment: Confirmation dialog title before removing a passkey.

settings.passkeys.removed.comment: Confirmation after a passkey is removed; {name} is its name.

settings.passkeys.unnamed.comment: Row title of a passkey that has no name.

settings.passkeys.unsupported_browser.text: This browser cannot manage passkeys. Use a recent Safari, Chrome, Firefox or Edge.
settings.passkeys.unsupported_browser.comment: Web only: the browser has no WebAuthn support.

settings.profile.error.generic.text: Could not save your name. Try again.

settings.profile.lede.text: How you appear to your contacts.
settings.profile.lede.comment: Line under the Profile title in Settings.

settings.profile.name.hint.text: Shown to the people you talk to. Not unique, at most {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
settings.profile.name.hint.comment: Note under the name field in Settings, Profile.

settings.profile.name.label.comment: Label of the display-name field in Settings > Profile.

settings.profile.preview.label.comment: Caption above the live preview of the name and username as contacts see them.

settings.profile.preview.no_name.text: Others see your key fingerprint until you set a name.
settings.profile.preview.no_name.comment: Preview text when the person has neither a name nor a username.

settings.profile.saved.text: Your name will update for your contacts.
settings.profile.saved.comment: Confirmation after the name is saved; contacts see it on their next message.

settings.profile.username.none.comment: Shown in place of the username when the account has none.

settings.recovery.contact.already_enable.text: An email or phone is already set for this account. To replace it, sign in again with your recovery phrase or from another device first.
settings.recovery.contact.already_enable.comment: The account already has a recovery email or phone.

settings.recovery.contact.done.text: Done. A code sent there can now get you back into your account.

settings.recovery.contact.error.bad_cont.text: That does not look right. Check it and try again.
settings.recovery.contact.error.bad_cont.comment: The server rejected the email address or phone number.

settings.recovery.contact.error.generic.text: Could not set up the email or phone. Try again.
settings.recovery.contact.error.generic.comment: Fallback for any other enrolment failure.

settings.recovery.contact.lede.text: A one-time code sent to your email or phone lets you sign in again if you lose your password.
settings.recovery.contact.lede.comment: Text under the Email or phone heading.

settings.recovery.contact.sent_email.text: We sent a six-digit code to {contact} by email. Enter it below.
settings.recovery.contact.sent_email.comment: {contact} is the email address, shown bold (rendered as an element).

settings.recovery.contact.sent_phone.text: We sent a six-digit code to {contact} by text message. Enter it below.
settings.recovery.contact.sent_phone.comment: {contact} is the phone number, shown bold (rendered as an element).

settings.recovery.contact.sub.text: A one-time code sent to your email or phone.
settings.recovery.contact.sub.comment: Line under Email or phone on the Recovery page, before the row is opened.

settings.recovery.contact.unavailable.text: Email and phone recovery are not available right now.
settings.recovery.contact.unavailable.comment: The server has email and phone recovery switched off.

settings.recovery.lede.text: Your recovery phrase restores everything. These get you back into the account when you have lost your password; your messages then come from the phrase or from another of your devices.
settings.recovery.lede.comment: Line under the Recovery title: what the authenticator and email/phone factors do and do not restore.

settings.recovery.phrase.not_saved_here.text: Not saved on this device. Keep your written copy safe.
settings.recovery.phrase.not_saved_here.comment: Recovery page: this device keeps no copy of the recovery phrase.

settings.recovery.phrase.saved_here.comment: Recovery page: this device keeps a copy of the recovery phrase in its secure storage.

settings.recovery.phrase.sub.text: The 24 words you wrote down at signup restore your identity, contacts and messages on a new device.
settings.recovery.phrase.sub.comment: Recovery page: what the recovery phrase restores.

settings.recovery.section.access.comment: Section heading on the Recovery page above the authenticator and email / phone rows: ways to get back into the account.

settings.recovery.section.identity.comment: Section heading on the Recovery page above the recovery phrase row: what restores who you are.

settings.recovery.sign_in_first.text: Sign in first to manage recovery.
settings.recovery.sign_in_first.comment: Recovery page opened without a ready session.

settings.recovery.title.comment: Title of the Recovery row in Security and of the Recovery page (authenticator, email or phone).

settings.recovery.totp.already_enabled.text: An authenticator is already set up for this account. To replace it, sign in again with your recovery phrase or from another device first.
settings.recovery.totp.already_enabled.comment: The account already has an authenticator; the server refuses a silent swap.

settings.recovery.totp.done.text: Authenticator set up. A code from the app can now get you back into your account.

settings.recovery.totp.error.generic.text: Could not set up the authenticator. Try again.
settings.recovery.totp.error.generic.comment: Fallback for any other enrolment failure.

settings.recovery.totp.error.wrong.text: That code did not work. Wait for the next code in the app and try again.
settings.recovery.totp.error.wrong.comment: The enrolment code was wrong or expired.

settings.recovery.totp.key.comment: Line under the QR code; {key} is the secret key in a code font (rendered as an element), for typing it in by hand.

settings.recovery.totp.lede.text: A six-digit code from an authenticator app lets you sign in again if you lose your password.
settings.recovery.totp.lede.comment: Text under the Authenticator app heading.

settings.recovery.totp.scan.text: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key in by hand, then enter the six-digit code the app shows.
settings.recovery.totp.scan.comment: Instruction above the enrolment QR code.

settings.recovery.totp.title.comment: Card heading for the authenticator-app recovery factor.

settings.recovery.totp.unavailable.text: Authenticator setup is not available right now.
settings.recovery.totp.unavailable.comment: The server has authenticator recovery switched off.

settings.section.account.comment: Settings section: sign out, forget this device, delete account.

settings.section.appearance.comment: Settings section: theme and text size.

settings.section.danger_zone.comment: Settings section heading above Log out, Forget this device and Delete account.

settings.section.media.comment: Settings section: camera, microphone and media options.

settings.section.network.comment: Settings section heading above the anti-censorship row.

settings.security.devices.sub.text: See, add and remove the devices on this account.
settings.security.devices.sub.comment: Subtitle of the Devices row in Settings > Security.

settings.security.lede.text: How you sign in, which devices can read your messages, and how you get back in.
settings.security.lede.comment: Line under the Security title in Settings.

settings.security.recovery.sub.text: An authenticator app, an email address or a phone number that gets you back in.
settings.security.recovery.sub.comment: Subtitle of the Recovery row in Settings > Security.

settings.security.safety_numbers.sub.text: Each contact has a safety number. Compare it in person or on a call; matching numbers mean nobody is in between. Find it in the contact's details.
settings.security.safety_numbers.sub.comment: Explains what a safety number is and how to compare it.

settings.security.safety_numbers.title.comment: Row title in Settings > Security explaining safety numbers.

username.a11y_hint.comment: Spoken by the screen reader for the reason under a username field. {message} is the reason, like 'At least 3 characters'.

username.error.empty.comment: Shown under the username field when it is empty.

username.error.invalid_characters.comment: Shown under the username field: usernames may only use a-z, 0-9 and underscore. Keep '_' as is.

username.error.too_long.text: At most {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
username.error.too_long.comment: Shown under the username field when it is too long; {count} is the maximum.

username.error.too_short.text: At least {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}
username.error.too_short.comment: Shown under the username field when it is too short; {count} is the minimum.

username.error.unknown.comment: Shown under the username field for any other refusal.

username.hint.shown_as.comment: Hint under a username field when the name is typed in another form (for example with capitals); {username} is how it will show, with @, like @alice.
